Subject: Draft: Redwood tenant log erasure playbook (v1)

Hi all — attaching a first-pass technical playbook. Highlights below; full details are in the attached PDF (redwood_aethertia_playbook_v1.pdf).

- Retention defaults: session traces and inference debug logs are retained 90 days by default; request/response tokens are purged from short-lived caches within 7 days unless persisted by customers. Persistent audit logs (for billing/metrics) are retained 365 days for hosted plans.
- Erasure flow (customer-initiated):
  1) Customer submits erasure request via API or Support ticket; unique erasure job ID created.
  2) System queues TTL purge + snapshot invalidation; KV cache keys are swept; backend marks tenant objects for deletion.
  3) Background worker performs physical deletion across S3 buckets and DB rows (consistent hashing), and emits a deletion_manifest.json containing object ids and timestamps.
  4) PoD generation: the platform compiles the deletion_manifest, signs it with KMS-managed key and generates an attestation (base64 signature + timestamp).
- Forensics and holds: an investigation hold toggles a preservation flag on the tenant; the standard flow stops step 3 and instead creates a forensics snapshot (read-only) accessible to support with auditable access logs. Holds require a ticket with justification and approval from Redwood Compliance.
- Edge cases: debug traces captured transiently by STT/observability agents may be present in ephemeral worker caches for up to 14 days; we can provide a targeted sampling plan for debug traces but full immediate deletion may not always be practical without a short processing window.

Attachment: redwood_aethertia_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 240 KB)

I'll be on the call Friday afternoon; happy to walk through implementation details.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Mapping PoD artifacts to SIG/CAIQ (notes)

Tom / team — quick compliance note set to accompany Priyom's playbook. I'm attaching a small index that maps the artifacts we mentioned to SIG/CAIQ controls and suggested evidence types.

Key points we call out in the index (see sig_attachment_index.csv):
- Deletion_manifest.json + KMS signature -> maps to SIG Auditability and CAIQ data_retention/disposal items; recommended evidence: signed manifest + S3 object delete markers + KMS key id.
- Forensics hold workflow -> map to SOC 2 CC6.2/CC7: documented approval chain + ticket id + preservation snapshot hashes.
- Timing guarantees -> we can commit operationally to a 48-hour processing window for tenant-initiated erasures for hosted customers provided there are no active legal holds or in-progress rolling exports; for dedicated/private installations timelines can vary and need specific SLAs.

Open items:
1) Whether Aethertia requires externally notarized PoD (we can support third-party notarization for an added compliance engagement).
2) Scope for ephemeral debug traces — we recommend a sampling-based attestation if you require immediate removal for all ephemeral traces.

Attachment: sig_attachment_index.csv (csv, 12 KB)

If useful we can include a short slide mapping for your audit team; happy to pair on the workshop.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Ben / team — thank you for the quick turnaround and the materials so far. A few clarifications before the workshop:

- PoD notarization: For our legal group an internally attested, KMS-signed manifest is acceptable for initial procurement review. Final procurement may request third-party notarization as a condition of enterprise contracting. Please include a short note on estimated time and cost for third-party notarization in your MAP.
- SLA ask: Our security policy requires a clear timeline for customer-initiated erasure. The 48-hour processing window is reasonable; please confirm this will be included as an operational commitment for hosted accounts in the MAP.
- Holds: If we place a preservation hold, we need confirmation that logs will be read-only and accessible to our auditors and that no automated deletion will occur. Please confirm the approval chain required on Redwood's side (role/title).

We have two tenant IDs to scope for the initial evidence pack: tenant-ae-07 and tenant-ae-staging. Can you confirm whether staging tenants follow the same retention policy or if they are excluded?

Happy to take the workshop; please propose times. Our internal sign-off date is still 5/24 so earlier is better.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Security Program Manager
Aethertia Therapeutics
